text_blocks.snippet: In Utah, a full roof replacement generally costs [Highlight start] between $10,000 and $30,000 [Highlight end] , with most standard asphalt shingle projects landing in the $8,000 to $20,000 range depending on home size, pitch, and materials.

list.snippet: Per Square Foot (Asphalt Shingles): Roughly $3.66 to $10.38 per sq. ft. installed.
~2,000 sq. ft. Home: Averages around $14,000 to $15,400 in Wasatch Front metros like Salt Lake City and Provo-Orem-Lehi.
Larger / Complex Homes (2,500+ sq. ft. or steep/mountain pitches): Can range from $10,500 to $24,000+ , and higher with metal or premium materials.

text_blocks.snippet: For local pricing breakdowns, see Superior Home Improvement or get a quick satellite estimate through SquareDash .

list.snippet: Climate & Snow Load: Heavy snow, freeze-thaw cycles, and high-altitude UV exposure in Utah favor durable underlayment, proper ventilation, and higher wind/impact ratings.
Roof Pitch & Complexity: Steep slopes, valleys, dormers, and multi-story layouts increase labor time and safety requirements.
Material Choice: Asphalt shingles are the most budget-friendly (20–30 year lifespan in Utah), while metal (40–70 years) and tile (50+ years) cost significantly more upfront.
Tear-Off & Decking: Removing old layers and replacing damaged plywood decking adds to the base quote.
Seasonality: Late winter to early spring (January–March) often offers lower demand and more flexible pricing, though weather windows can be tight.

text_blocks.snippet: In homeowner discussions on , opinions are mixed on Utah replacement costs—with quotes on a ~2,600 sq. ft. roof ranging widely from $5,000 to over $23,850 depending on roof pitch, complexity, tear-off needs, and decking repairs.

If you share your approximate square footage, preferred roofing material (such as asphalt shingle or metal), and city or county (for example, Heber City or Summit/Wasatch County), I can help narrow down a more realistic estimate.
